name: Show Anything
summary: Universal preview node that accepts any input type (image, text, video, audio, JSON) and auto-detects the content type for display. Inspired by ComfyUI's 'easy showAnything' node. Renders images inline, plays video/audio with controls, and displays text/JSON in a scrollable monospace view.

inputs.description: Any content — image, text, video, audio, or JSON. Type is auto-detected from the data format.

outputs.description: Pass-through output when content is an image.
Pass-through output when content is text, JSON, or non-image data.

executionNotes: Display-only node. Content is received automatically via useEffect when upstream data changes — no manual execution required. Content type detection: base64 image data or image URLs → 'image', video data/URLs → 'video', audio data/URLs → 'audio', valid JSON → 'json' (displayed pretty-printed), everything else → 'text'. A content-type badge is shown in the header. The output handle ID dynamically switches between 'image' and 'text' based on detected type.

exampleConnections.scenario: Display the physiognomic description of a selected talent.
View the full JSON metadata of a selected talent.
Preview a generated image with auto-type detection.
